name: TrendChart
intent: A titled card wrapping a themed ECharts trend/analysis chart (line / bar) — the reusable chart tile in an analytics report. Removes the repeated Card + CardTitle + chart boilerplate.
when: A line/bar trend or analysis chart inside a report or dashboard
A grid of comparable chart cards (headcount, cost burn, safety, ...)
You were about to hand-roll a Card + raw ECharts again
whenNot: Rendering an AI-GENERATED chart payload -> use CoreChartRenderer (it renders DashboardWidget.chartData)
A single headline number -> use MetricCard
A bare, unframed chart with no card/title -> use the Chart (ChartContainer) primitive directly

chooseOver.because: Chart is the bare themed ECharts wrapper; TrendChart adds the Card + title (+ optional legend header) so report chart tiles aren't re-implemented each time.
CoreChartRenderer renders AI-generated chart PAYLOADS (DashboardWidget.chartData); TrendChart renders a hand-authored ECharts option for a fixed report chart.

option.note: The ECharts option (series / axes / tooltip / grid). The caller builds it from its data.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless — no data fetching. The caller maps its series into an ECharts option.

header.note: Extra header content under the title — e.g. a custom legend.

seriesThemes.note: Semantic tone or chart color index per ECharts series; resolved to canvas-safe RGB.

states.default: A Card with a title and a themed chart of the given option.
states.with-legend: header renders a custom legend (color swatches + labels) under the title.
states.no-header: title and header both omitted -> just the framed chart.

allowedPlacement: chart grid in a report / dashboard
inside a content region as a chart tile

commonMistakes.mistake: Using TrendChart to render an AI-generated chart payload
commonMistakes.fix: Use CoreChartRenderer for AI payloads; TrendChart is for a hand-authored ECharts option.

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-implementing the Card + raw ECharts wrapper
commonMistakes.fix: Use TrendChart; pass title, optional header (legend), and option.

commonMistakes.mistake: Putting a custom legend in the wrong place
commonMistakes.symptom: Legend not aligned with the title
commonMistakes.fix: Pass it via the `header` slot (rendered in the CardHeader under the title).

commonMistakes.mistake: Passing CSS var(...) or oklch(...) directly as a series color
commonMistakes.symptom: The chart frame renders but a series is invisible
commonMistakes.fix: Pass seriesThemes such as [{tone: "primary"}, {colorIndex: 2}]; TrendChart resolves them to canvas-safe RGB.
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Do not use unresolved CSS Color 4 strings in TrendChart ECharts series colors.

ownership.expectedWrapper: An unstyled dashboard grid cell; TrendChart owns its Card background, border, and padding.

evaluationCriteria.check: TrendChart chosen for a hand-authored report chart tile — not CoreChartRenderer (AI payloads), MetricCard (a number), or bare Chart.
option is a valid EChartsOption; the caller builds it from its data.
Composes Chart (ChartContainer) inside a Card — does not re-init echarts by hand.
Renders a titled Card with a chart of the given option.

notes: promotedFrom: the repeated raw ReactECharts chart cards in packages/components/src/pages/core-org-performance.tsx (Regular Dashboard chart-grid region).
originated in the core-org-performance chart-grid region before that page left the template catalog.
refactored: ["core-org-performance now composes TrendChart for its trend chart cards (raw ReactECharts -> Chart/ChartContainer via TrendChart); same options, themed rendering."]
siblings: CoreChartRenderer renders AI-generated chart payloads; TrendChart renders hand-authored options. Kept separate by design.
